authored_on: the SHNEITZER laptop, which has no tile data, no uv and no GPU -- so no arm of this run COULD have been executed before the bar was written
question: The tile-rung selection run scored `max_tx` as primary and returned SELECTION_IS_THE_BOTTLENECK (bar A 2/10). The hybrid arm then measured `hybrid_conv_maxtx` as the best scorer on this rung by correlation. Does the hybrid, substituted as primary scorer into the SAME unchanged bar, clear bar A at k=10?

the_only_thing_that_changes.everything_else: UNCHANGED from scripts/glm_tile_selection.py::PREREGISTERED -- at_k, baseline_scorer, both thresholds, min_seeds_passing, the verdict rule and the substrate
the_only_thing_that_changes.why_this_matters: the bar was frozen with primary_scorer max_tx before any tile number was read. Asking whether a DIFFERENT scorer clears the SAME bar is legitimate. Re-sizing the bar to fit the new scorer would not be, and is forbidden here.

inherited_bar_restated_verbatim.bar_a_meaning: the primary scorer realises at least half the AVAILABLE selection value
inherited_bar_restated_verbatim.bar_b_effective_margin: max(0.10, 2 * permutation-null stdev at that seed and k)
inherited_bar_restated_verbatim.thresholds_are: ASSERTED, not derived; the per-trial ceiling arm that normalises them IS derived
inherited_bar_restated_verbatim.source: scripts/glm_tile_selection.py::PREREGISTERED, read 2026-10-17; bar B's max(0.10, 2*sd) was verified in the verdict() source, not inferred from the rendered memo

family_size_declared_up_front.why: this is the SECOND scorer put to this bar. A bar tested against scorer after scorer until one passes is a garden of forking paths, and the honest defence is to state the family before running, not after.

untested_and_deliberately_NOT_in_this_ru.why_excluded: it is closer to the bar than conv and a plausible future candidate, but it was not the hybrid arm's winner. Naming it here means a later run cannot present it as a first look.
measured WORSE than hybrid_conv_maxtx on correlation (+0.4217 vs +0.4254); adding it would widen the family for no expected gain.

family_size_declared_up_front.rule: if hybrid_conv_maxtx fails bar A, do NOT substitute a third scorer into this bar without a fresh pre-registration that carries this family count forward.

selection_basis_is_independent_of_this_b.claim: hybrid_conv_maxtx was NOT chosen because it passed anything. It was chosen because it was the best MEASURED scorer on this rung by Spearman (+0.4254 median vs max_tx +0.3968), in a separate run with its own pre-registered protocol and its own clean control.
selection_basis_is_independent_of_this_b.control_that_run_already_passed: max_tx rank-averaged with a SHUFFLED conv scores -0.1232, 0/10 seeds, CI95 [-0.1275, -0.1187] -- a content-free vector HURTS, so the hybrid's gain is the conv's content.

anchor_run_refuses_without_it.rule: the re-run's `max_tx` arm must reproduce the committed per-seed headroom_captured at k=10 within 0.01 on at least 9 of 10 seeds, against [0.498, 0.480, 0.471, 0.457, 0.513, 0.496, 0.482, 0.457, 0.517, 0.476] for seeds 0-9, and its cross-seed mean within 0.005 of 0.4847.
anchor_run_refuses_without_it.on_miss: REFUSE the whole comparison (exit 3) and report the mismatch. A hybrid-vs-bar verdict computed off a pipeline that no longer reproduces the number the bar was frozen against is not a measurement of the hybrid.
anchor_run_refuses_without_it.why: this mirrors the project's own M4 raw-reconciliation gate and the FBA reconcile gate, both of which caught real divergences -- the FBA one surfaced a duplicate-gene-symbol bug via a 0.0003 discrepancy.

fairness_constraints: hybrid and max_tx must be scored on the SAME seeds, the SAME leave_peak_out splits and the SAME candidate pools -- only the scorer differs.
the conv component must be fitted on each seed's own training split, never on held-out peaks, so the rank-average introduces no second-level leakage.
the permutation null must be recomputed for the hybrid rather than reusing max_tx's, because bar B's effective margin depends on the null stdev at that seed and k.

a `control_shuffled_conv_maxtx` arm must be scored through the IDENTICAL selection path. If a shuffled-conv hybrid also clears bar A, the run is REFUSED as uninformative -- that would mean the bar is passable by a content-free vector and the metric, not the scorer, is what moved.

k_is_frozen_at_10_and_this_is_the_load_b.rule: k=10 is the ONLY bar-bearing k.
k_is_frozen_at_10_and_this_is_the_load_b.why: the k-trend on this rung is monotone (max_tx 0.3880 -> 0.4468 -> 0.4847 -> 0.5366 at k=2/5/10/20), so max_tx ALREADY clears 0.50 at k=20. Letting k float would let the run choose the k that passes, which measures the analyst and not the scorer.
k_is_frozen_at_10_and_this_is_the_load_b.k20_is_reported_as_pre_declared_secondar: yes -- descriptive only, explicitly NOT bar-bearing, and it may not be quoted as clearing the bar.

third_quantity_reported_but_NOT_bar_bear.what: paired per-seed headroom delta, hybrid minus max_tx at k=10, with a bootstrap CI95 on the median
third_quantity_reported_but_NOT_bar_bear.why_reported: bar A is absolute and bar B is against gc, so neither asks whether the hybrid actually moved the SELECTION metric relative to the incumbent. The hybrid's correlation gain is CI-positive; whether that converts into selection value is a separate question and is the one a reader will want.
third_quantity_reported_but_NOT_bar_bear.why_not_bar_bearing: adding a third bar after seeing the first run's result would be re-sizing. It is declared here so it can be neither inflated into a pass nor buried on a miss.

expectation_stated_honestly.direction: a pass is PLAUSIBLE but not assured, and this is written down so a near-miss cannot be spun as a win.
expectation_stated_honestly.naive_extrapolation_and_why_it_is_NOT_a_: the hybrid's correlation is 7.2% above max_tx's; applied naively to max_tx's 0.4847 headroom that lands near 0.520, just over the bar. This is NOT a prediction -- headroom_captured is a normalised selection outcome, not a monotone function of Spearman, and the project has a recorded instance of exactly this kind of cross-metric extrapolation failing (the designed grid's 0.7937 did not transfer to this rung).
expectation_stated_honestly.do_not_conflate: NEXT.md's '42.2% -> 45.2% of the 0.941 ceiling' figures are SPEARMAN normalised by the ceiling. They are not headroom_captured and must not be compared to the 0.50 bar.

verdict_rule.ORACLE_READY_AS_SCORING_HEAD: bar A and bar B both pass on >= 6 of 10 seeds -- the hybrid converts its correlation into a choice, and further prediction work on this rung has measured diminishing returns FOR THE GENERATIVE GOAL
verdict_rule.CRUDE_BASELINE_SUFFICES: bar A passes, bar B fails -- gc does the work
verdict_rule.SELECTION_IS_THE_BOTTLENECK: bar A fails -- even the best measured scorer on this rung cannot convert correlation into a choice at k=10, so prediction work IS justified
verdict_rule.INDETERMINATE_INSUFFICIENT_SEEDS: fewer than 6 seeds produced a scoreable pool; the bar is unreachable by construction and no substantive verdict may be printed
verdict_rule.REFUSED_ANCHOR_MISMATCH: the max_tx arm did not reproduce the committed numbers
verdict_rule.REFUSED_CONTROL_ALSO_PASSED: the shuffled-conv hybrid also cleared bar A

what_a_PASS_would_license: describing hybrid_conv_maxtx as an adequate RANKING head for the tile rung at k=10.
de-prioritising further scoring-head work on THIS rung relative to generator work.
what_a_PASS_would_NOT_license: A DOSING claim. The combine is a label-free, parameter-free rank-average: it ranks and does not dose, the same deployability class as the inverse cell. 'Ready as a scoring head' means ready to ORDER candidates.

Settling the self-distillation precondition. Whether a learned component that contributes only in combination satisfies the ban's 'forbidden until a learned representation lands' precondition is an OPEN USER AUTHORITY CALL recorded in NEXT.md. A bar cannot pre-empt it, and this run is not evidence for either side of it.
Overturning the G-A encoder gate. That gate asked whether the conv beats one GC number and its CI includes zero. This asks something different and both results stand together.
Any claim about a generator. The candidate pool is MEASURED peak tiles; a generator's candidates sit off this distribution where no label exists.
honest_scope: UPPER BOUND on the loop's selection value -- measured peak tiles, not generator output.
Peak tiles are selected from ChIP peaks, so the pool is enriched for real promoters relative to the genome; selection is EASIER here than on random sequence.
ONE rung, ONE experiment (GEO GSE144621, 44106 tiles, leave_peak_out frac=0.25, ceiling 0.941), ONE combine rule.
conv and max_tx are both ridge-fitted on the same split, so their errors may be correlated through the SPLIT rather than through the biology -- carried over from the hybrid arm's own limits.
Cross-seed means pool over leave-peak-out splits of one experiment. The designed-grid anchor (0.7937) pooled over element axes. Different pooling units; not a stricter bound, a different one.
A negative does not show that no learned representation can add here -- only that THIS hybrid, at THIS k, on THIS rung, does not clear an ASSERTED 0.50.
